note: TestDelCrossingDeleteAnswersWithoutAPairedDelete runs the production crossing sequence (recordOwnDelete, send, remove) and asserts the response to the peer's crossing Delete carries no Delete payload; reddens when crossOwnDelete stops detecting the crossing. TestDelWithoutOwnDeleteTheSameRequestIsPaired pins the row's own 'In that case' scope: outside the exception the same Delete draws the paired Delete §1.4.1 requires ('Normally, the response ... will contain Delete payloads for the paired SAs'), so a responder that never pairs cannot pass. The tags on TestLcyInformationalResponseCarriesNoDeletePayload are gone and its stale premise rewritten.
